facts.fact: The PMAY-G dashboard on pmayg.dord.gov.in shows 3,20,36,728 houses completed in total (Phase-I + Phase-II cumulative)
facts.quote: 3,20,36,728 COMPLETED TILL NOW Cumulative completions overall

facts.fact: That dashboard figure is as on 28/10/2026 (the dashboard updates live)
facts.quote: Phase-I Phase-II Cumulative (Phase-I + II) Year-Wise Distribution (As on: 28/10/2026 )

behaviour: Gives the cumulative number of PMAY-G houses completed from the official PMAY-G dashboard (pmayg.dord.gov.in) or MIS, with the as-on date, citing it; a later figure from the same dashboard with its own as-on date is acceptable.
fail_if: It gives a completion figure without an as-on date or source, invents a number, or gives a PMAY-Urban figure.
summary: PMAY-G home dashboard (as on 28/10/2026): 3,20,36,728 houses completed cumulatively (Phase-I + II).
